basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a 22-year-old gamer and fashion enthusiast based in Seattle. I spend most of my online hours in the evenings, trading items in Royale High and battling it out in Apex Legends. When I'm not gaming, I binge-watch reality TV, with Real Housewives being my guilty pleasure. Currently, I'm working part-time as a barista while studying graphic design. I'm single and enjoy spending my weekends exploring the local cosplay scene.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've been an avid gamer since high school, honing my skills in RPGs like Xenoblade Chronicles 2. My knowledge of Royale High comes from countless hours of gameplay and trading in the community. I also have a knack for keeping up with the latest reality TV gossip, which I discuss frequently with friends and online communities.
